---
title: "Piano Sonata"
year: 2016
note: This is an instrumental generative work. Because of that, it is recommended that performers generate a new version of this work for each new performance. Performers are welcome to play more than one version in the same concert, in order to illustrate the algorithmic character of this composition.
instrumentation: "piano"
duration: on average, ca. 32'00"
date: 2016-01-12
score: "/assets/scores/Piano Sonata.zip"
---
*Piano Sonata* is an algorithmic composition which rewrites itself for every performance: its score is generated by a computer program, which rigorously follows the composer's structural ideas and rules, but also makes small decisions by itself via the use of randomly generated numbers. Thus, every little detail in this work is follows logical principles but yet are unforeseen, making two scores generated by the same program look alike but never be the same.

Composed in 2016, though first sketches date back to 2013.
